d1_objective: The learner sees a wrong three-tap kernel reproduce a steady constant observation exactly, then sees an impulse probe separate the taps and permit a validated convolution fit.

implementation.client_boundary: use client is the first line; default export; no props
implementation.initial_state: constant probe with [0.90,0.05,0.10], matching the true tap sum 1.05 while failing impulse validation
implementation.controls: two PresetGroups, three kit Sliders, one kit Readout, all inside Panel
implementation.visual: responsive dependency-free eight-sample SVG with discrete input stems and paired observed/candidate output stems
implementation.error_rule: normalized L2; zero/zero returns 0 and nonzero prediction against zero target returns Infinity/fail
implementation.pass_rule: every absolute tap error <= 0.01 + 1e-9 and held-out impulse error < 0.01

self_review.D1: PASS: constant agreement and impulse disagreement update visibly with the convolution model.
self_review.D2: PASS: all eight-by-three arithmetic and SVG geometry derive synchronously with no async work.
self_review.D3: PASS: the initial wrong-same-sum counterexample is nondegenerate and four named presets are provided.
self_review.D4: PASS: the lesson task can reach a numeric PASS requiring both tap and impulse-error gates.
self_review.D5: PASS: one 125-line client file, existing UI imports only, no network, context, CSS file, or dependency.
self_review.accessible: PASS: native kit buttons/ranges provide keyboard and 44px touch targets; labelled groups, aria-valuetext, live status, SVG alt text, mark shapes, and text legends avoid color-only meaning.
self_review.mobile_theme_ranges: PASS by code review: stacked default layout, sm-only three-column controls, fluid viewBox, currentColor/theme tokens, finite dynamic scale at every slider endpoint.
self_review.registry_validation: DEFERRED: shared components/demos/index.ts was intentionally not edited; the closing owner must add the lazy import before interactive page inspection.

manual_after_registry_lands: Inspect desktop and 360px in light and dark themes.
Keyboard-select both probes and all presets, then arrow each slider through both endpoints.
Confirm the initial constant traces agree at 0.00% without passing, the impulse separates the first three samples, Threshold pass succeeds at 0.94%, and manual tuning clears the active preset.
